title: A Parallelized Framework for Multi-Distribution Neutrosophic Synthetic Data on Apache Spark
summary: Official code for a paper proposing a Spark-parallelized neutrosophic method for generating multi-distribution synthetic tabular data, with benchmarking scripts comparing it against GAN-based synthesis on datasets like diabetes and wine quality. The benchmark script trains and samples SDV's CTGANSynthesizer as a comparison baseline against the paper's own copula-based (GaussianMultivariate) and neutrosophic generation methods.
